field_principles.ambiguous_rows: Ambiguous rows count prefixes with more than one valid completion.
field_principles.branch_factor_rows: Branch counts measure the exact candidate cost for each prefix.
field_principles.contradiction_rows: Contradiction rows prove conflicting subject relations fail closed.
field_principles.duplicate_rows: Duplicate rows prove repeated relations fail closed.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time shows the bounded fixture builder executed.
field_principles.exact_engine_disagreement_count: Zero is required before exact labels can be consumed.
field_principles.exact_engine_parity_rows: Parity rows make every disagreement visible before readiness.
field_principles.feasible_branch_rows: Feasible branch rows show which next lines preserve completion.
field_principles.field_principles: A reason per field keeps the artifact contract auditable.
field_principles.final_exact_engine_rows: Clingo rows keep final exact authority separate from guidance.
field_principles.fixture_manifest: The manifest freezes families, cases, bounds, and split identities.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Expected and observed values make every blocked gate actionable.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix lets the conductor classify this completed run safely.
field_principles.impossible_rows: Impossible rows preserve rejected prefixes instead of dropping them.
field_principles.in_loop_exact_engine_rows: Direct-engine rows expose every candidate-level decision.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The fixed CPU declaration proves that no model inference ran.
field_principles.late_failure_rows: Late rows prove that an initially valid branch can fail later.
field_principles.latency_rows: Measured per-engine latency supports later branch-cost comparisons.
field_principles.model_inference_call_count: Zero proves the canary used no proposal model.
field_principles.no_headroom_rows: No-headroom rows expose invalid full programs that cannot extend.
field_principles.positive_rows: Positive rows preserve all prefixes with at least one valid completion.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact admission checks prevent drift from entering the canary.
field_principles.prefix_case_rows: Case rows retain one complete prefix-level decision receipt.
field_principles.prefix_viability_canary_ready_score: One opens the next gate only after every check passes.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed non-ID seed identifies deterministic fixture construction.
field_principles.rejected_branch_rows: Rejected branch rows show the exact cost of pruning bad lines.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A timing-free hash detects changes in scientific content.
field_principles.retired_mechanism_activation_count: Zero proves retired generation mechanisms stayed off.
field_principles.rows: Branch rows retain each source, prefix, candidate line, and exact decision.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the result to its exact code and evidence inputs.
field_principles.source_group_split_rows: Group rows prove that canary and held sources do not overlap.
field_principles.unsupported_rows: Unsupported rows prove unknown relation atoms fail closed.
field_principles.verdict_class: The closed class prevents oracle evidence from becoming positive evidence.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True discloses that exact engines define fixture correctness.
field_principles.witness_rows: Witness rows provide replayable valid completions for positive decisions.
